routing.simple_fixed_flux: FSI_TOP_MODE_EXPLICIT_FLUX remains bound exclusively to top_boundary_provider_t and preserves the qualified F-SI28 ABI and behavior.
routing.dynamic: FSI_TOP_MODE_DYNAMIC_PROVIDER requires an associated dynamic_top_boundary_provider_t. No implicit fallback to legacy boundtop or the simple provider is allowed.
routing.dynamic_flux: Set ftoph=false and qtop=result.actual_top_flux; the existing HeadCalc residual retains F(1)+=qtop.
routing.dynamic_head: Set ftoph=true, hsurf=result.surface_head and kmean(1)=result.surface_face_conductivity; the existing HeadCalc residual retains F(1)-=kmean(1)*gradient and the existing top Jacobian retains +kmean(1)/grid_disnod(1).
routing.runoff: Set candidate ponding from result.candidate_ponding_depth and runots from result.runoff_depth. The rich provider resolves runoff, so legacy pondrunoff is not invoked on the dynamic route.

mass_balance.legacy_expression: pond-pondm1 + epd*dt + reva*dt - (nraidt+nird+melt)*dt - runon*dt + runots - qtop*dt
mass_balance.basis: F-SI29 defines net_potential_surface_flux = precipitation + irrigation + snowmelt + runon - bare_soil_evaporation - ponded_water_evaporation.
mass_balance.rule: When the dynamic provider is active, the convergence pond-balance check must use only the rich provider result plus explicit trial state; it must not read hidden legacy forcing globals for these terms.

lifecycle.candidate_ponding: existing candidate physical state, committed only by the outer transaction

fail_closed: dynamic mode without an associated dynamic provider
associated dynamic provider used with a non-dynamic top mode
regime other than FLUX or HEAD
HEAD regime with nonpositive surface-face conductivity
dynamic result without surface mass terms or resolved runoff
